required_transformations: Aggregate user-level data to daily signup counts by city tier
Calculate conversion rate using derived converted_flag by acquisition channel
Compute 7-day retention rate using retained_7d_flag by cohort week
Remove all direct identifiers and credential fields from output
justification: Aggregate outputs are sufficient to answer all three business questions, making raw user-level export unnecessary
Minimum data principle: Only fields marked as minimal_internal_query are allowed for internal computation
Password hash and auth token must never be released externally per policy
Derived flags (converted_flag, retained_7d_flag) are preferred over raw timestamps like last_active_date
